ai_question: Why do you need to take some days off next week?
sample_pattern: I need to take some days off because I have a medical checkup.
common_mistakes: Missing 'because' before the reason clause
follow_up_question: What day do you want your leave to start?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'take days off' for vacation/leave. 'Because' must be followed by a full clause (subject + verb).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'take days off' khi xin nghỉ phép. Sau 'because' phải là một mệnh đề đầy đủ (chủ ngữ + động từ).

ai_question: How many days do you want to take off?
sample_pattern: I want to take two days off, from Monday to Tuesday.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on 'day' when the number is more than one
follow_up_question: Why do you need these two days off?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to 'day' when talking about more than one day (plural noun).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào 'day' khi nói về nhiều hơn một ngày (danh từ số nhiều).

ai_question: When do you need your leave to start?
sample_pattern: My leave needs to start this Friday.
common_mistakes: Using 'in Friday' instead of 'on Friday'
follow_up_question: And when will you be back at work?
grammar_explanation_en: Use the preposition 'on' before a day of the week (on Friday), not 'in' or 'at'.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng giới từ 'on' trước ngày trong tuần (on Friday), không dùng 'in' hoặc 'at'.

ai_question: When will you come back to work?
sample_pattern: I will come back to work next Monday.
common_mistakes: Wrong tense: using present simple instead of future 'will'
follow_up_question: Will you check your email while you are away?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'will' + base verb to talk about a future plan.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'will' + động từ nguyên mẫu để nói về kế hoạch trong tương lai.

ai_question: Who will do your work while you are away?
sample_pattern: My colleague, Ms. Lan, will do my work while I am away.
common_mistakes: Forgetting 'while' + subject + verb structure
follow_up_question: Has Ms. Lan agreed to help you?
grammar_explanation_en: 'While' introduces a clause with its own subject and verb to show two actions happening at the same time.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'While' mở đầu một mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và động từ riêng để diễn tả hai hành động xảy ra cùng lúc.

ai_question: Have you told your manager about your leave yet?
sample_pattern: Yes, I have already told my manager about my leave.
common_mistakes: Using past simple 'told' alone instead of present perfect 'have told'
follow_up_question: What did your manager say?
grammar_explanation_en: Use present perfect (have/has + past participle) for an action completed before now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + động từ phân từ 2) cho hành động đã hoàn thành tính đến hiện tại.

ai_question: Is this a sick leave or a personal leave?
sample_pattern: This is a sick leave because I am not feeling well.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before an -ing verb or adjective
follow_up_question: Do you need to see a doctor?
grammar_explanation_en: Do not forget the verb 'to be' (am/is/are) before an -ing verb or adjective.
grammar_explanation_vi: Đừng quên động từ 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing hoặc tính từ.

ai_question: Do you need a doctor's note for this leave?
sample_pattern: Yes, I need a doctor's note for this leave.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive 's on 'doctor'
follow_up_question: When can you get the doctor's note?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 's after a noun to show possession (doctor's note = the note that belongs to the doctor).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 's sau danh từ để chỉ sự sở hữu (doctor's note = giấy của bác sĩ).

ai_question: Can you finish your report before you leave?
sample_pattern: Yes, I can finish my report before I leave.
common_mistakes: Wrong word order after 'before'
follow_up_question: What time will your report be ready?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Before' is followed by a subject and a verb (before + subject + verb) to show the order of two actions.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Before' theo sau bởi chủ ngữ và động từ (before + chủ ngữ + động từ) để chỉ thứ tự của hai hành động.

ai_question: What time is your meeting with the client today?
sample_pattern: My meeting with the client is at three o'clock today.
common_mistakes: Using 'in three o'clock' instead of 'at three o'clock'
follow_up_question: Where will the meeting take place?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'at' before a clock time (at three o'clock).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'at' trước giờ cụ thể (at three o'clock).

ai_question: Where are you meeting the client?
sample_pattern: I am meeting the client at our office on the fifth floor.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the -ing form
follow_up_question: Is the meeting room ready?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a verb ending in -ing for actions happening now or soon.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing cho hành động đang hoặc sắp xảy ra.

ai_question: How do you usually greet a new client?
sample_pattern: I usually greet a new client with a smile and a handshake.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject 'I' — note 'usually' needs base verb
follow_up_question: What do you say after the handshake?
grammar_explanation_en: With 'I/you/we/they', the verb keeps its base form in the present simple (I greet).
grammar_explanation_vi: Với chủ ngữ 'I/you/we/they', động từ giữ nguyên dạng gốc ở thì hiện tại đơn (I greet).

ai_question: What do you usually say to start the meeting?
sample_pattern: I usually say, 'Thank you for coming today.'
common_mistakes: Missing 'for' before the -ing verb
follow_up_question: What is the first topic you talk about?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'thank you for' + verb-ing to thank someone for an action.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'thank you for' + động từ đuôi -ing để cảm ơn ai đó vì một hành động.

ai_question: Did the client arrive on time yesterday?
sample_pattern: Yes, the client arrived on time yesterday.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: How long did the meeting last?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (arrive -> arrived).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (arrive -> arrived).

ai_question: What does the client want to know about your product?
sample_pattern: The client wants to know the price and the delivery time.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject 'the client'
follow_up_question: Do you have the price list ready?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to the verb when the subject is he/she/it or a singular noun (the client wants).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào động từ khi chủ ngữ là he/she/it hoặc danh từ số ít (the client wants).

ai_question: Can you show the client your presentation now?
sample_pattern: Yes, I can show the client my presentation now.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'presentation'
follow_up_question: How many slides does your presentation have?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your/his/her) before a noun you own.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your/his/her) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: Is the client happy with your service?
sample_pattern: Yes, the client is happy with our service.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'with' after 'happy'
follow_up_question: What did the client say exactly?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Happy' is followed by the preposition 'with' when talking about being satisfied with something.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Happy' đi kèm giới từ 'with' khi nói về sự hài lòng với điều gì đó.

ai_question: What do you need to prepare before meeting a client?
sample_pattern: I need to prepare a proposal and some samples.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a' before a singular countable noun
follow_up_question: Do you have the samples ready today?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a/an' before a singular countable noun (a proposal).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a/an' trước danh từ đếm được số ít (a proposal).

ai_question: What time does your team meeting start?
sample_pattern: My team meeting starts at nine in the morning.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject
follow_up_question: How long does the meeting usually last?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to the verb for he/she/it in the present simple (the meeting starts).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào động từ cho chủ ngữ he/she/it ở thì hiện tại đơn (the meeting starts).

ai_question: How often do you have team meetings?
sample_pattern: We have team meetings twice a week.
common_mistakes: Wrong word order for frequency expression
follow_up_question: Which days are your team meetings?
grammar_explanation_en: Frequency expressions like 'twice a week' usually go at the end of the sentence.
grammar_explanation_vi: Các cụm chỉ tần suất như 'twice a week' thường đặt ở cuối câu.

ai_question: Who leads your team meeting?
sample_pattern: My manager leads our team meeting.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject
follow_up_question: What does your manager usually talk about?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to the verb when the subject is a singular noun (my manager leads).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào động từ khi chủ ngữ là danh từ số ít (my manager leads).

ai_question: What do you usually talk about in team meetings?
sample_pattern: We usually talk about our progress and our problems.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before the noun
follow_up_question: What problem did you discuss last time?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (our/my/your) before a noun to show ownership.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (our/my/your) trước danh từ để chỉ sự sở hữu.

ai_question: Did everyone attend the meeting yesterday?
sample_pattern: No, one person did not attend the meeting yesterday.
common_mistakes: Using 'didn't attended' with a double past marker
follow_up_question: Why was that person absent?
grammar_explanation_en: In negative past sentences, use 'did not/didn't' + base verb, not the past form (didn't attend, not didn't attended).
grammar_explanation_vi: Trong câu phủ định thì quá khứ, dùng 'did not/didn't' + động từ nguyên mẫu, không dùng dạng quá khứ (didn't attend, không phải didn't attended).

ai_question: Do you take notes during team meetings?
sample_pattern: Yes, I take notes during team meetings.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' — check for singular vs plural, 'I' keeps base form
follow_up_question: Who reads the notes after the meeting?
grammar_explanation_en: With 'I/you/we/they', the verb stays in its base form in the present simple (I take).
grammar_explanation_vi: Với chủ ngữ 'I/you/we/they', động từ giữ nguyên dạng gốc ở thì hiện tại đơn (I take).

ai_question: Is your team meeting online or in the office?
sample_pattern: Our team meeting is online this week.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the adjective
follow_up_question: What app do you use for the online meeting?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective (the meeting is online).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ (the meeting is online).

ai_question: Can you share your screen in the meeting?
sample_pattern: Yes, I can share my screen in the meeting.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'screen'
follow_up_question: What will you show on your screen?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: What did your team decide in the last meeting?
sample_pattern: Our team decided to finish the project by Friday.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: Is the project on schedule now?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (decide -> decided).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (decide -> decided).

ai_question: What is the status of your project today?
sample_pattern: My project is on schedule today.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the adjective phrase
follow_up_question: Is there anything blocking your progress?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective or adjective phrase (my project is on schedule).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ hoặc cụm tính từ (my project is on schedule).

ai_question: How much of the task have you finished?
sample_pattern: I have finished about eighty percent of the task.
common_mistakes: Using past simple instead of present perfect
follow_up_question: When do you think you will finish the rest?
grammar_explanation_en: Use present perfect (have/has + past participle) to talk about progress up to now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + động từ phân từ 2) để nói về tiến độ tính đến hiện tại.

ai_question: What did you do yesterday on this project?
sample_pattern: Yesterday, I finished the first part of the report.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: What will you do today?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (finish -> finished).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (finish -> finished).

ai_question: Do you have any problems to report today?
sample_pattern: Yes, I have one small problem with the schedule.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a/one' before a singular countable noun
follow_up_question: How can the team help you solve it?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a/an' or a number like 'one' before a singular countable noun (one problem).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a/an' hoặc số từ như 'one' trước danh từ đếm được số ít (one problem).

ai_question: When will you complete this task?
sample_pattern: I will complete this task by Friday.
common_mistakes: Using 'until Friday' instead of 'by Friday' for a deadline
follow_up_question: Do you need any extra help to meet that deadline?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'by' + time to show a deadline (by Friday), not 'until'.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'by' + thời gian để chỉ hạn chót (by Friday), không dùng 'until'.

ai_question: Is your update ready for the manager?
sample_pattern: Yes, my update is ready for the manager.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the adjective
follow_up_question: Would you like to send it now or present it in the meeting?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective (my update is ready).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ (my update is ready).

ai_question: Who is helping you with this task?
sample_pattern: My coworker, Tuan, is helping me with this task.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the -ing form
follow_up_question: What part is Tuan helping with?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a verb ending in -ing for an action happening now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing cho hành động đang xảy ra.

ai_question: Did you meet your deadline last week?
sample_pattern: Yes, I met my deadline last week.
common_mistakes: Using base form 'meet' instead of the irregular past 'met'
follow_up_question: What helped you finish on time?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Meet' is an irregular verb; its past simple form is 'met', not 'meeted'.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Meet' là động từ bất quy tắc, dạng quá khứ đơn là 'met', không phải 'meeted'.

ai_question: How many tasks do you have this week?
sample_pattern: I have three tasks this week.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the plural noun after a number
follow_up_question: Which task is the most difficult?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to a countable noun after a number greater than one (three tasks).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được sau số lớn hơn một (three tasks).

ai_question: Can you tell me a little about yourself?
sample_pattern: I am a hardworking person who likes to learn new things.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the noun phrase
follow_up_question: What do you like to learn most?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a noun phrase describing yourself (I am a person who...).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước cụm danh từ mô tả bản thân (I am a person who...).

ai_question: Why do you want to work for our company?
sample_pattern: I want to work for your company because it has a good reputation.
common_mistakes: Missing 'because' before the reason clause
follow_up_question: What do you know about our products?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Because' must be followed by a full clause (subject + verb) to give a reason.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Because' phải theo sau bởi một mệnh đề đầy đủ (chủ ngữ + động từ) để đưa ra lý do.

ai_question: What are your strengths?
sample_pattern: My strengths are teamwork and good communication.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the plural noun 'strength'
follow_up_question: Can you give an example of your teamwork?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to make a countable noun plural when there is more than one (strengths).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được khi có nhiều hơn một (strengths).

ai_question: What is your biggest weakness?
sample_pattern: My biggest weakness is that I sometimes work too slowly.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'the' before the superlative adjective
follow_up_question: How are you trying to improve on that?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'the' before a superlative adjective (the biggest weakness).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'the' trước tính từ so sánh nhất (the biggest weakness).

ai_question: Where did you work before this job?
sample_pattern: I worked at a small company before this job.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: What did you do at that company?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (work -> worked).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (work -> worked).

ai_question: How many years of experience do you have?
sample_pattern: I have three years of experience in this field.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on 'year' after a number greater than one
follow_up_question: What did you learn in those three years?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to a countable noun after a number greater than one (three years).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được sau số lớn hơn một (three years).

ai_question: Do you work well in a team?
sample_pattern: Yes, I work well in a team.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'in' before 'a team'
follow_up_question: Can you describe a time you worked in a team?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'in' before a group noun like 'a team' (work in a team).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'in' trước danh từ chỉ nhóm như 'a team' (work in a team).

ai_question: What is your highest level of education?
sample_pattern: My highest level of education is a bachelor's degree.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive 's on 'bachelor'
follow_up_question: What did you study in university?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 's after a noun to show possession (bachelor's degree).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 's sau danh từ để chỉ sự sở hữu (bachelor's degree).

ai_question: What is the topic of your presentation today?
sample_pattern: The topic of my presentation today is our new product.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'presentation'
follow_up_question: How long is your presentation?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: How many slides do you have?
sample_pattern: I have ten slides for my presentation.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on 'slide' after a number greater than one
follow_up_question: Which slide is the most important one?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to a countable noun after a number greater than one (ten slides).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được sau số lớn hơn một (ten slides).

ai_question: Are you nervous about presenting today?
sample_pattern: Yes, I am a little nervous about presenting today.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before an adjective
follow_up_question: What helps you feel less nervous?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective describing a feeling (I am nervous).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ diễn tả cảm xúc (I am nervous).

ai_question: How do you usually start your presentation?
sample_pattern: I usually start my presentation with a short introduction.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'with' before the noun
follow_up_question: What do you say in your introduction?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'with' before the thing you begin something with (start with an introduction).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'with' trước điều bắt đầu bằng (start with an introduction).

ai_question: Did you practice your presentation before today?
sample_pattern: Yes, I practiced my presentation twice before today.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: Did practicing help you feel more ready?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (practice -> practiced).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (practice -> practiced).

ai_question: Who is your audience today?
sample_pattern: My audience today is the sales team.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'audience'
follow_up_question: What does the sales team want to know?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: Do you use pictures in your slides?
sample_pattern: Yes, I use pictures to make my slides more interesting.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to' before the base verb after 'to make'
follow_up_question: What kind of pictures do you use?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to' + base verb to explain a purpose (to make my slides more interesting).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to' + động từ nguyên mẫu để giải thích mục đích (to make my slides more interesting).

ai_question: How long will your presentation take?
sample_pattern: My presentation will take about fifteen minutes.
common_mistakes: Missing 'about' before the approximate time
follow_up_question: Is there time for questions after?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'about' before an approximate number or time (about fifteen minutes).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'about' trước số hoặc thời gian ước lượng (about fifteen minutes).

ai_question: Hi! How are you today?
sample_pattern: I am fine, thank you. How about you?
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the adjective
follow_up_question: That's great to hear! What are your plans today?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective describing how you feel (I am fine).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ diễn tả cảm giác (I am fine).

ai_question: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
sample_pattern: Good morning! Yes, I slept well, thank you.
common_mistakes: Using base verb 'sleep' instead of the irregular past 'slept'
follow_up_question: What are you doing this morning?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Sleep' is an irregular verb; its past simple form is 'slept', not 'sleeped'.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Sleep' là động từ bất quy tắc, dạng quá khứ đơn là 'slept', không phải 'sleeped'.

ai_question: What is your name?
sample_pattern: My name is Khoa. Nice to meet you.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the name
follow_up_question: Nice to meet you too, Khoa. Where are you from?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (is) to introduce your name (my name is...).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (is) để giới thiệu tên (my name is...).

ai_question: Where are you from?
sample_pattern: I am from Vietnam.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'from' before the country
follow_up_question: Which city in Vietnam are you from?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'from' before the place you come from (I am from Vietnam).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'from' trước nơi mình đến (I am from Vietnam).

ai_question: How is your family doing?
sample_pattern: My family is doing well, thank you for asking.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the -ing form
follow_up_question: Do you live with your family?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a verb ending in -ing (my family is doing well).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing (my family is doing well).

ai_question: Long time no see! What have you been doing?
sample_pattern: I have been working a lot these days.
common_mistakes: Using present simple instead of present perfect continuous
follow_up_question: Are you still working at the same company?
grammar_explanation_en: Use present perfect continuous (have/has been + verb-ing) for an action continuing up to now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành tiếp diễn (have/has been + động từ -ing) cho hành động tiếp diễn đến hiện tại.

ai_question: Nice weather today, isn't it?
sample_pattern: Yes, it is really nice today.
common_mistakes: Missing 'it' as the subject for weather sentences
follow_up_question: Do you have any plans to enjoy the weather?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'it' as the subject when talking about the weather (it is nice).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'it' làm chủ ngữ khi nói về thời tiết (it is nice).

ai_question: How was your weekend?
sample_pattern: My weekend was great. I visited my parents.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: What did you do with your parents?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (visit -> visited).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (visit -> visited).

ai_question: What would you like to order for your lunch?
sample_pattern: I would like to order a chicken burger and a coke, please.
common_mistakes: Missing 'please' at the end of a polite request
follow_up_question: Would you like anything else with that?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'I would like to + verb' or 'I'd like + noun' to order politely, and add 'please'.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'I would like to + động từ' hoặc 'I'd like + danh từ' khi gọi món lịch sự, thêm 'please'.

ai_question: Would you like anything to drink?
sample_pattern: Yes, I would like a glass of water, please.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a' before 'glass'
follow_up_question: Still or sparkling water?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a' before a singular countable unit (a glass of water).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a' trước đơn vị đếm được số ít (a glass of water).

ai_question: Is the food here spicy?
sample_pattern: Yes, some dishes here are quite spicy.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the adjective
follow_up_question: Do you enjoy spicy food?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before an adjective (dishes are spicy).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước tính từ (dishes are spicy).

ai_question: Do you want your steak well done or medium?
sample_pattern: I want my steak medium, please.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'steak'
follow_up_question: Would you like any sauce with your steak?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: Did you enjoy your meal?
sample_pattern: Yes, I enjoyed my meal very much.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: What dish did you like the most?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (enjoy -> enjoyed).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (enjoy -> enjoyed).

ai_question: Do you have any food allergies I should know about?
sample_pattern: I don't have any food allergies.
common_mistakes: Missing 'don't' auxiliary in the negative sentence
follow_up_question: Great, is there anything you don't like to eat?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'don't' + base verb for negative sentences with I/you/we/they in the present simple.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'don't' + động từ nguyên mẫu cho câu phủ định với I/you/we/they ở thì hiện tại đơn.

ai_question: Can I get you some more rice?
sample_pattern: Yes, please. I would like some more rice.
common_mistakes: Missing 'some' before an uncountable noun
follow_up_question: Would you like anything else with your rice?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'some' before an uncountable noun in an offer or request (some more rice).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'some' trước danh từ không đếm được trong lời đề nghị hoặc yêu cầu (some more rice).

ai_question: How do you like your coffee?
sample_pattern: I like my coffee with a little sugar.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'coffee'
follow_up_question: Do you drink coffee every day?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: Can I help you find something?
sample_pattern: Yes, I am looking for a new jacket.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the -ing form
follow_up_question: What color jacket do you want?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a verb ending in -ing (I am looking).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing (I am looking).

ai_question: What size do you wear?
sample_pattern: I wear a medium size.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a' before 'medium size'
follow_up_question: Would you like to try it on?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a' before a singular countable noun phrase (a medium size).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a' trước cụm danh từ đếm được số ít (a medium size).

ai_question: Do you want to try it on?
sample_pattern: Yes, I want to try it on, please.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to' before the base verb after 'want'
follow_up_question: The fitting room is over there.
grammar_explanation_en: 'Want' is followed by 'to' + base verb (want to try).
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Want' đi kèm 'to' + động từ nguyên mẫu (want to try).

ai_question: How much does this shirt cost?
sample_pattern: This shirt costs twenty dollars.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject
follow_up_question: Is there a discount today?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to the verb for a singular subject in the present simple (this shirt costs).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào động từ cho chủ ngữ số ít ở thì hiện tại đơn (this shirt costs).

ai_question: Is there a discount on this item?
sample_pattern: Yes, there is a twenty percent discount on this item.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a' before 'discount'
follow_up_question: Does the discount apply to all sizes?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a' before a singular countable noun (a discount).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a' trước danh từ đếm được số ít (a discount).

ai_question: What color do you prefer, black or white?
sample_pattern: I prefer black to white.
common_mistakes: Using 'than' instead of 'to' after 'prefer'
follow_up_question: Do you have this shirt in black?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'prefer A to B' to compare two preferences, not 'than'.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'prefer A to B' để so sánh hai điều thích hơn, không dùng 'than'.

ai_question: Did you buy anything else today?
sample_pattern: Yes, I bought a pair of shoes today.
common_mistakes: Using base form 'buy' instead of the irregular past 'bought'

grammar_explanation_en: 'Buy' is an irregular verb; its past simple form is 'bought', not 'buyed'.
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Buy' là động từ bất quy tắc, dạng quá khứ đơn là 'bought', không phải 'buyed'.

ai_question: Do you accept credit cards?
sample_pattern: Yes, we accept credit cards here.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the plural noun 'card'
follow_up_question: Do you also accept cash?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to make a countable noun plural (card -> cards).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' để tạo danh từ số nhiều (card -> cards).

ai_question: Excuse me, where is the nearest bus stop?
sample_pattern: The nearest bus stop is next to the bank.
common_mistakes: Missing 'the' before 'nearest bus stop'
follow_up_question: How far is it from here?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'the' before a superlative adjective like 'nearest' (the nearest bus stop).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'the' trước tính từ so sánh nhất như 'nearest' (the nearest bus stop).

ai_question: How do I get to the train station from here?
sample_pattern: You can walk straight and turn left at the corner.
common_mistakes: Missing 'at' before the location word 'corner'
follow_up_question: How many minutes does it take to walk there?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'at' before a specific point like a corner (turn left at the corner).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'at' trước một điểm cụ thể như góc đường (turn left at the corner).

ai_question: Is the supermarket far from here?
sample_pattern: No, the supermarket is not far from here.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb in the negative sentence
follow_up_question: How many minutes does it take to walk there?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' + not (is not) before an adjective in a negative sentence.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' + not (is not) trước tính từ trong câu phủ định.

ai_question: Which way is the hospital?
sample_pattern: The hospital is that way, on your right.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'on' before 'your right'
follow_up_question: Is it a big hospital?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'on' before 'your right/left' to give directions (on your right).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'on' trước 'your right/left' để chỉ đường (on your right).

ai_question: Can you show me the way to the park?
sample_pattern: Yes, the park is two blocks from here.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on 'block' after a number greater than one
follow_up_question: Is there a shortcut through the alley?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to a countable noun after a number greater than one (two blocks).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được sau số lớn hơn một (two blocks).

ai_question: Do I need to take a taxi, or can I walk there?
sample_pattern: You can walk there; it is not too far.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb in the negative sentence
follow_up_question: How long does it take on foot?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' + not (is not) before an adjective in a negative sentence.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' + not (is not) trước tính từ trong câu phủ định.

ai_question: How long does it take to get to the airport?
sample_pattern: It takes about thirty minutes to get to the airport.
common_mistakes: Missing 'it' as the subject for time expressions
follow_up_question: Should we leave now to avoid traffic?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'it' as the subject when talking about time or distance (it takes thirty minutes).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'it' làm chủ ngữ khi nói về thời gian hoặc khoảng cách (it takes thirty minutes).

ai_question: Is there a pharmacy near here?
sample_pattern: Yes, there is a pharmacy near here.
common_mistakes: Missing article 'a' before a singular countable noun
follow_up_question: Is it open right now?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'a' before a singular countable noun (a pharmacy).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'a' trước danh từ đếm được số ít (a pharmacy).

ai_question: Where are you going on your next trip?
sample_pattern: I am going to Da Nang on my next trip.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to be' verb before the -ing form
follow_up_question: How long will you stay there?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'to be' (am/is/are) before a verb ending in -ing (I am going).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'to be' (am/is/are) trước động từ đuôi -ing (I am going).

ai_question: How do you usually travel, by plane or by car?
sample_pattern: I usually travel by plane.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'by' before the mode of transport
follow_up_question: Do you like flying?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'by' before a mode of transport (by plane, by car).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'by' trước phương tiện di chuyển (by plane, by car).

ai_question: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
sample_pattern: Yes, I have already packed my suitcase.
common_mistakes: Using past simple instead of present perfect
follow_up_question: Did you forget anything important?
grammar_explanation_en: Use present perfect (have/has + past participle) for a completed action relevant to now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + động từ phân từ 2) cho hành động đã hoàn thành liên quan đến hiện tại.

ai_question: What time does your flight leave?
sample_pattern: My flight leaves at seven in the morning.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on the verb with a singular subject
follow_up_question: What time do you need to arrive at the airport?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to the verb for he/she/it in the present simple (my flight leaves).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào động từ cho chủ ngữ he/she/it ở thì hiện tại đơn (my flight leaves).

ai_question: Do you have your passport with you?
sample_pattern: Yes, I have my passport with me.
common_mistakes: Missing possessive adjective before 'passport'
follow_up_question: Is your passport still valid?
grammar_explanation_en: Use a possessive adjective (my/your) before a noun that belongs to you.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng tính từ sở hữu (my/your) trước danh từ thuộc về mình.

ai_question: Did you enjoy your last vacation?
sample_pattern: Yes, I enjoyed my last vacation a lot.
common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'
follow_up_question: Where did you go on that vacation?
grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (enjoy -> enjoyed).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (enjoy -> enjoyed).

ai_question: Where will you stay during your trip?
sample_pattern: I will stay at a small hotel near the beach.
common_mistakes: Missing preposition 'at' before the accommodation
follow_up_question: Is the hotel expensive?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'at' before a place you stay (stay at a hotel).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'at' trước nơi ở (stay at a hotel).

ai_question: How many bags are you bringing?
sample_pattern: I am bringing two bags.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' on 'bag' after a number greater than one
follow_up_question: Do you need help carrying them?
grammar_explanation_en: Add 's' to a countable noun after a number greater than one (two bags).
grammar_explanation_vi: Thêm 's' vào danh từ đếm được sau số lớn hơn một (two bags).

ai_question: What do you like to do in your free time?
sample_pattern: I like to read books in my free time.
common_mistakes: Missing 'to' before the base verb after 'like'
follow_up_question: What kind of books do you like to read?
grammar_explanation_en: 'Like' can be followed by 'to' + base verb (like to read).
grammar_explanation_vi: 'Like' có thể đi kèm 'to' + động từ nguyên mẫu (like to read).

ai_question: Do you play any sports?
sample_pattern: Yes, I play football on weekends.
common_mistakes: Missing 's' — check base form with 'I' subject
follow_up_question: How often do you play?
grammar_explanation_en: With 'I/you/we/they', the verb stays in its base form in the present simple (I play).
grammar_explanation_vi: Với chủ ngữ 'I/you/we/they', động từ giữ nguyên dạng gốc ở thì hiện tại đơn (I play).

ai_question: How long have you had this hobby?

follow_up_question: How did you first get interested in it?
grammar_explanation_en: Use present perfect (have/has + past participle) with 'for' to show duration up to now.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành (have/has + động từ phân từ 2) với 'for' để chỉ khoảng thời gian tính đến hiện tại.

ai_question: Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?

grammar_explanation_en: Use 'prefer A to B' to compare two preferences, not 'than'.
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'prefer A to B' để so sánh hai điều thích hơn, không dùng 'than'.

ai_question: Can you play any musical instruments?

follow_up_question: How long have you been playing the guitar?
grammar_explanation_en: Use 'the' before the name of a musical instrument (play the guitar).
grammar_explanation_vi: Dùng 'the' trước tên nhạc cụ (play the guitar).

ai_question: When did you start this hobby?

common_mistakes: Using base verb instead of past form '-ed'

grammar_explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past simple (start -> started).
grammar_explanation_vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm '-ed' ở thì quá khứ đơn (start -> started).

follow_up_question: What is your favorite type of movie?
grammar_explanation_en: With 'I/you/we/they', the verb stays in its base form in the present simple (I watch).
grammar_explanation_vi: Với chủ ngữ 'I/you/we/they', động từ giữ nguyên dạng gốc ở thì hiện tại đơn (I watch).

ai_question: Do you enjoy cooking at home?
sample_pattern: Yes, I enjoy cooking at home very much.

follow_up_question: What is your favorite dish to cook?

grammar_explanation_vi: 'Enjoy' đi kèm động từ đuôi -ing (enjoy cooking), không dùng dạng nguyên mẫu.
